hooks.command: bash -c 'S=$(cat .claude/current_session.txt 2>/dev/null || echo unknown); if echo "$S" | grep -qi merge; then echo "Merge session — assessment not required"; else if [ ! -f "docs/assessments/session-${S}-assessment.md" ]; then echo "WARNING: Assessment file missing for session ${S} (create before ending)" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -f "docs/session_logs/session-${S}-log.md" ]; then echo "WARNING: Session log missing: docs/session_logs/session-${S}-log.md (create before ending)" >&2; exit 1; fi; fi; if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then echo "WARNING: Uncommitted files (commit before ending session)" >&2; git status --porcelain >&2; exit 1; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"tool_input\",{}).get(\"command\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "\bgit commit\b"; then if [ -f .claude/parallel_session_active ]; then BRANCH=$(git branch --show-current); if [ "$BRANCH" = "main" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: Cannot commit to main during parallel session." >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo "."); bash "$REPO/scripts/test-gate.sh" fast 2>&1 | tail -5; fi'
bash -c 'S=$(cat .claude/current_session.txt 2>/dev/null || echo "?"); osascript -e "display notification \"Session ${S}: Awaiting input\" with title \"Claude Code\"" 2>/dev/null; exit 0'
